# Dhiman Seal - Software Engineer, Open-Source Creator, and Entrepreneur

> Last updated: August 17, 2026

Dhiman Seal is a Software Engineer 2 at Rippling. He previously worked at
Groww, where his portfolio documents payment infrastructure handling 300K+
daily transactions and real-time data systems serving 13M+ users.

## Selected evidence

- Software Engineer 2, Full-Stack at Rippling since May 2026
- Four years at Groww across internship and Software Engineer roles
- Payment systems handling 300K+ daily transactions
- Real-time data infrastructure serving 13M+ users
- Open-source packages used by 1.5K+ development teams
- 6 ventures documented in the portfolio, including AgriJod, OnlyForms,
  Banalo, Eminence Robotics, TechEngio, and EzHomeo
- National Winner, Tata Imagination Challenge 2024
- National Runner-up, ONDC Build for Bharat 2024
